notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Brash Taunter lifelink.
Your life total is at least 51.
description:
Give Brash Taunter lifelink.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying fifty life, dealing fifty damage to Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing fifty damage to an opponent and causing you to gain fifty life.
Repeat from step 2.
